t: Comancheria was the domain of the Nʉmʉnʉʉ, a people who moved from the Shoshone homelands onto the southern Plains around 1700.
Horses and bison sustained a decentralised society of bands and divisions that traded and raided from New Mexico to Texas and Mexico.
Epidemics, the destruction of the bison and US campaigns ended its independence; the last band surrendered at Fort Sill in 1875.
dyk: In 1944 fourteen Comanche code talkers landed at Utah Beach with the US 4th Infantry Division, using their own language to pass army messages in Normandy.
ev: Spanish records first mention the Comanche, allied with the Utes, near Taos
Comanches and allies attack the Spanish mission of San Sabá in Texas
Juan Bautista de Anza’s expedition kills the war leader Cuerno Verde
Ecueracapa concludes peace with New Mexico under Governor Anza
Council House Fight in San Antonio; Buffalo Hump leads a great raid to the coast
The Medicine Lodge Treaty assigns a reservation in Indian Territory
Mackenzie’s troops destroy the Comanche horse herd in Palo Duro Canyon
Quanah Parker’s Kwahadi band surrenders at Fort Sill

f.predecessor: Shoshone peoples of the Great Basin
